verses.original: ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων ὁ καὶ κοινωνός τῆς δόξης μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι παρακαλῶ Πρεσβυτέρους τοὺς ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ho sympresbyteros kai martys tōn tou Christou pathēmatōn ho kai koinōnos tēs doxēs mellousēs apokalyptesthai parakalō Presbyterous tous en hymin
verses.literal: [As] a fellow elder - a witness of - Christ’s sufferings - and a partaker of the glory vvv to be revealed I appeal to [the] elders - among you

verses.original: ποιμάνατε τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ ποίμνιον ἐν ὑμῖν ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως Θεόν κατὰ μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως
verses.transliteration: poimanate tou Theou to poimnion en hymin episkopountes mē anankastōs alla hekousiōs Theon kata mēde aischrokerdōs alla prothymōs
verses.literal: Be shepherds - of God’s - flock [that is] among you watching over them not out of compulsion but willingly as God would have you not out of greed but out of eagerness

verses.original: μηδ’ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ γινόμενοι τύποι τοῦ ποιμνίου
verses.transliteration: mēd’ hōs katakyrieuontes tōn klērōn alla ginomenoi typoi tou poimniou
verses.literal: not vvv lording it over - those entrusted to you but being examples to the flock

verses.original: καὶ τοῦ Ἀρχιποίμενος φανερωθέντος κομιεῖσθε τὸν στέφανον τῆς δόξης ἀμαράντινον
verses.transliteration: kai tou Archipoimenos phanerōthentos komieisthe ton stephanon tēs doxēs amarantinon
verses.literal: And [when] the Chief Shepherd appears you will receive the crown - of glory that will never fade away

verses.original: νεώτεροι Ὁμοίως ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις δὲ πάντες ἐγκομβώσασθε τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἀλλήλοις ὅτι Ὁ Θεὸς ἀντιτάσσεται ὑπερηφάνοις δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν ταπεινοῖς
verses.transliteration: neōteroi Homoiōs hypotagēte presbyterois de pantes enkombōsasthe tēn tapeinophrosynēn allēlois hoti Ho Theos antitassetai hyperēphanois de didōsin charin tapeinois
verses.literal: Young men in the same way submit yourselves to [your] elders And all [of you] clothe yourselves - with humility toward one another because - God opposes [the] proud but gives grace to [the] humble

verses.original: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα ἵνα ἐν καιρῷ ὑψώσῃ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Tapeinōthēte oun hypo tou Theou tēn krataian cheira hina en kairō hypsōsē hymas
verses.literal: Humble yourselves therefore under - God’s - mighty hand so that in [due] time He may exalt you

verses.original: ἐπιρίψαντες πᾶσαν ὑμῶν τὴν μέριμναν ἐπ’ αὐτόν ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: epiripsantes pasan hymōn tēn merimnan ep’ auton hoti autō melei peri hymōn
verses.literal: Cast all your - anxiety on Him because He cares for you

verses.original: Νήψατε γρηγορήσατε ὑμῶν ἀντίδικος ὁ διάβολος περιπατεῖ ὡς ὠρυόμενος λέων ζητῶν τινα καταπιεῖν
verses.transliteration: Nēpsate grēgorēsate hymōn antidikos ho diabolos peripatei hōs ōryomenos leōn zētōn tina katapiein
verses.literal: Be sober-minded [and] alert Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion seeking [someone] to devour

verses.original: ἀντίστητε ᾧ στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει εἰδότες ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐπιτελεῖσθαι τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων
verses.transliteration: antistēte hō stereoi tē pistei eidotes hymōn adelphotēti tē en tō kosmō epiteleisthai ta auta tōn pathēmatōn
verses.literal: Resist [him] [standing] firm in [your] faith [and] in the knowledge that your brothers - throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering

verses.original: δὲ παθόντας ὀλίγον Ὁ Θεὸς πάσης χάριτος ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτοῦ αἰώνιον τὴν δόξαν ἐν Χριστῷ αὐτὸς καταρτίσει στηρίξει σθενώσει θεμελιώσει
verses.transliteration: de pathontas oligon Ho Theos pasēs charitos ho kalesas hymas eis autou aiōnion tēn doxan en Christō autos katartisei stērixei sthenōsei themeliōsei
verses.literal: And [after you] have suffered for a little while the God of all grace who has called you to His eternal - glory in Christ will Himself restore [you] secure [you] strengthen [you] [and] establish [you]

verses.original: αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: autō to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: To Him [be] the power vvv vvv forever [and] ever Amen

verses.original: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ λογίζομαι ὡς τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν δι’ ὀλίγων παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ στῆτε εἰς ἣν
verses.transliteration: Dia Silouanou logizomai hōs tou pistou adelphou egrapsa hymin di’ oligōn parakalōn kai epimartyrōn tautēn einai alēthē charin tou Theou stēte eis hēn
verses.literal: Through Silvanus [whom] I regard as a faithful brother I have written to you - briefly encouraging [you] and testifying [that] this is [the] true grace - of God Stand firm in [it]

verses.original: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς καὶ μου ὁ υἱός Μάρκος
verses.transliteration: hē en Babylōni syneklektē Aspazetai hymas kai mou ho huios Markos
verses.literal: [The church] in Babylon chosen together with [you] sends you greetings . . . [as does] my - son Mark

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης Εἰρήνη πᾶσιν ὑμῖν τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati agapēs Eirēnē pasin hymin tois en Christō
verses.literal: Greet one another with a kiss of love Peace to all of you who [are] in Christ
